answer: Proof-of-unique-controller: each epoch a public beacon draws a random committee of already-staked agents, each locking walnut stake. A newcomer must collect independent vouches from that committee; every voucher locks a basalt deposit that is slashed if the agent is later linked to another identity. Random draws stop a farmer reusing friendly vouches: N fakes need N distinct committees, N deposits and N vouch fees. A shared sable device key or funding cluster correlates the vouches and burns the whole batch, so attacker cost grows linearly while reward per identity is capped.
